title: Autonomous Coding Production Readiness Roadmap
goal: Move the autonomous coding foundation from proven backend pieces to a reliable workstation-first project-runner workflow that can be monitored and controlled remotely through Telegram.

relationship_to_existing_roadmaps.this_track_focus: Production orchestration, resumability, project scope, MCP workbench verification, remote status/control and deployment gates.
relationship_to_existing_roadmaps.telegram_role: Remote monitor and control channel, not the primary development workspace.

implemented_foundation: routes/coding_agent_routes.py exposes task-plan, quality-gate, worktree-quality-gate, sandbox-checks, done-gate, patch-set, publish-plan and subagents-plan endpoints.
src/coding_agent_backend.py already provides task plans, worktree creation gates, patch-set application gates, quality/done gates, publish plans and subagent contracts.
src/coding_agent_sandbox_bridge.py and tests/test_coding_agent_sandbox_bridge.py provide a sandbox check bridge and redacted evidence path.
src/server_project_runner.py provides repo-only universal project runner planning with deploy/Cloudflare gates that do not execute live actions.
plugins/telegram/plugin.py already records redacted task pause/resume/cancel/status control events in the agent task ledger.
src/tool_capability_maintenance.py and related tests cover post-update capability knowledge refresh foundations.
src/coding_project_scope.py resolves repo/project references into bounded allowed_paths, checks, branch policy and sandbox policy with ambiguous-name blocking.
src/coding_agent_sandbox_bridge.py now emits redacted evidence bundles and src/coding_agent_runner_state.py consumes sandbox dispatch results into review_ready or blocked runner phases.
src/agent_task_ledger.py exposes metadata-only coding-agent control events and src/coding_agent_runner_state.py consumes pause/resume/cancel events without starting unrestricted execution.
src/coding_agent_backend.py and src/server_project_runner.py expose explicit operator_gate and evidence_summary metadata for commit, push, deploy and Cloudflare handoff plans.
missing_or_not_yet_durable: Live workstation-to-Telegram smoke and real deploy/Cloudflare exposure remain gated until explicit operator Go.

target_user_stories.request: Ich erstelle am Rechner eine Roadmap, Odysseus arbeitet Slice fuer Slice daran.
target_user_stories.expected_result: The project runner opens a scoped coding task, creates/uses an isolated worktree, runs sandbox checks, records evidence and waits at gates.

target_user_stories.request: Ich frage unterwegs per Telegram: Wie weit ist der Lauf?
target_user_stories.expected_result: Telegram reads the redacted task ledger and reports current slice, blockers, progress and recommended next decision.

target_user_stories.request: Per Telegram: Pause, weiter, abbrechen oder Gate freigeben.
target_user_stories.expected_result: Telegram writes safe control events that the runner consumes before starting the next action.
Commit, push and deployment are explicit gated phases with evidence, no automatic production mutation without operator Go.

slice_queue.goal: Reconcile current coding-agent backend, sandbox, task ledger, Telegram remote controls and project runner state.
slice_queue.done_when: Current capabilities and gaps are documented without changing runtime code.
slice_queue.evidence: Current-state audit recorded existing coding agent routes/backend, sandbox bridge, server project runner, Telegram task controls and tool capability maintenance; it also documents missing runner-state and project-scope files, and reorders the safe sequence before publish/deploy gates.

slice_queue.goal: Make workstation-created coding tasks durable and queryable through a neutral task control plane.
slice_queue.done_when: Workstation task-plan creation writes a redacted coding_agent_task record and /api/coding-agent/tasks can list it.
slice_queue.evidence: Initial slice implemented in commit 4f9a767a: task-plan writes workstation surface records; safe repo target refs are preserved.

slice_queue.goal: Add a resumable coding runner state machine for planned, scoped, worktree_ready, checks_running, blocked, review_ready, publish_ready, done and failed.
slice_queue.done_when: Runner state survives restarts, blocks on gates, and records next_human_decision without raw diffs or private prompts.
slice_queue.evidence: Implemented src/coding_agent_runner_state.py with a JSON-persisted phase machine, safe transitions, gate/blocker metadata and raw-content redaction; routes/coding_agent_routes.py now writes runner state on task-plan, worktree and publish-plan and exposes a redacted runner-state read endpoint. Focused tests cover persistence, invalid transitions, secret/path rejection, no raw objective persistence and route integration.

slice_queue.goal: Resolve a project/roadmap slice into repo_id, allowed_paths, checks, branch policy and sandbox policy before coding starts.
slice_queue.done_when: Ambiguous project names block with a clear decision request; resolved scopes are bounded and owner-safe.
slice_queue.evidence: Implemented src/coding_project_scope.py with redacted project-query hashing, exact/fuzzy repo lookup, ambiguity blockers, bounded repo-relative paths, branch policy and dry-run sandbox policy. routes/coding_agent_routes.py exposes POST /api/coding-agent/project-scope. Focused tests cover exact resolution, ambiguous blocking, path rejection, branch-policy blockers, route redaction and unsafe check rejection.

slice_queue.goal: Let the runner dispatch allowlisted checks to the Podman sandbox and consume evidence into the quality gate.
slice_queue.done_when: Checks run in dry-run or approved live sandbox mode, artifacts are redacted, and failures become actionable blockers.
slice_queue.evidence: Implemented redacted sandbox evidence bundles in CodingSandboxDispatch and transition_from_sandbox_dispatch() for runner-state consumption. Dry-run or successful sandbox dispatch moves the runner to review_ready with operator_review gate; failed/blocked sandbox checks move it to blocked with sandbox_check_failure and actionable blockers. Focused tests cover dry-run evidence, live failure simulation, review_ready transitions and blocked transitions.

slice_queue.goal: Use the MCP workbench as an optional verification plane for local Odysseus readiness, browser evidence and read-only Podman status when available.
slice_queue.done_when: The runner can reference MCP evidence contracts without exposing generic shell/filesystem/Docker control.

slice_queue.goal: Make Telegram pause/resume/cancel/status events first-class control inputs consumed by the coding runner.
slice_queue.done_when: Remote control affects only the selected task, never exposes raw content, and never starts unrestricted execution.
slice_queue.evidence: Implemented metadata-only read_task_control_events() for coding_agent_task pause/resume/cancel events and transition_from_task_control_event() in the runner state machine. Pause and cancel move the selected runner to blocked gates; resume clears a Telegram pause gate and returns to a progress-derived safe phase without launching work. Focused tests cover Telegram command event filtering, pause/resume/cancel runner transitions and non-coding task rejection.

slice_queue.goal: Standardize commit, push, deploy and Cloudflare-tunnel publish gates as explicit reviewed phases.
slice_queue.done_when: Commit/push/deploy plans are generated with evidence and require explicit operator gate before mutation.
slice_queue.evidence: CodingPublishPlan now serializes operator_gate, evidence_summary, mutation_allowed and raw_content_visible=false. ServerProjectRunnerPlan now serializes operator_gate and evidence_summary for push remote, deploy target, backup/smoke/rollback evidence and Cloudflare tunnel request state. Focused tests verify dry-run plans remain non-mutating, operator-go plans expose explicit mutation gates and private/host content remains redacted.

slice_queue.goal: After coding-agent updates, refresh tool capability knowledge and Memory/RaptorGraph summaries so Odysseus knows its own current capabilities.
slice_queue.done_when: Maintenance AI can refresh tool index and capability memories after updates without raw private content.

slice_queue.goal: Run one harmless live flow: create coding task from workstation, query status and pause/resume through Telegram, no real deployment.
slice_queue.done_when: The server records a workstation-started task, Telegram reports it, pause/resume is consumed, and evidence is stored redacted.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve a harmless workstation-created coding task and Telegram status/control smoke on Debian.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Remote controls could affect the wrong task or start work without reviewed scope.

blocks: real deploy or Cloudflare tunnel publish
gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve exact target, branch, service and rollback plan for any deploy.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Production state could change without operator review.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Install/enable corresponding MCP services in Codex/Odysseus when available, then run bounded smoke tests.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: The runner may rely on unverified MCP tools or overly broad control surfaces.

success_metrics: Coding tasks are started primarily from workstation/project-runner state.
Telegram can monitor and control active tasks without being the main workspace.
Runner state is durable and resumable after restart.
Commit, push and deploy are explicit gated phases.
Odysseus can refresh its tool/capability self-knowledge after updates.
